Cederroth Triangular Cloth Bandage is a versatile first aid bandage designed to provide support for an injured arm or help secure a wound dressing. It can also be used when treating injuries involving the head, making it a useful addition to first aid kits and emergency care supplies. The kit contains 2 triangular bandages and 6 safety pins, providing the necessary components for practical first aid applications.
